slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single truck visit the same customer more than once during its route, or must each customer be served exactly once by exactly one truck?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each customer must be served exactly once by exactly one truck, covering the single-vehicle-per-customer hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do all trucks have to return to the central depot after completing their route, or is it acceptable for a truck to end its route at its last customer?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot or can end at the last customer, covering the depot-return hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent never entered READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling state; it continued repeating unresolved travel-time/distance questions through turn 30. Both P1 hidden slots were resolved, but there was no clear stop.
